location_qualifier: lower Lunga River / Lunga Road airfield area
source_locator: R2251: C25080307000 p. 2 (stamp 1308), 11th and 13th Construction Units in the lower Lunga River area on the morning of 7 August, and p. 3 (stamp 1309), withdrawal that night to a naval headquarters about 3 km west of the Matanikau
current_activity: at the Lunga airfield when the US landing began
notes: JACAR 南太平洋作戦 第７編 (C25080307000 p. 2, stamp 1308) places the 11th Construction Unit, with the 13th, in the lower Lunga River area on the morning of 7 August 1942, under Colonel Monzen (門前大佐). The same item (p. 3, stamp 1309) has the construction units withdraw on the night of the 7th to a naval headquarters position about 3 km west of the Matanikau. The 17th Army operations record (C25080232800 p. 11, stamp 0449) describes an unnamed naval construction unit of about 1,600 laborers at Lunga that morning; it is the same family and is not used to raise confidence. Confidence 0.5 (one Japanese official family; a Miller or Zimmerman page naming the 11th at Lunga on this date was not copied in this increment). Place is Henderson Field (PL4898), the airfield they were building in the lower Lunga district. Coord reference R2224.
